name: crane-nemotron-nano-4b
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16 (config.json max_position_embeddings 262144). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16: 42 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 128) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. crane-nemotron-nano-4b is nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16 (NemotronH: Mamba-2 state-space layers interleaved with attention) put through continued pretraining on East African language data, one unified capability-SFT pass, then GRPO for language consistency and tool triggering, and released in BF16 at the base's own parameter count. Architecture and tensor set unchanged; only weights moved. The card is candid about what did not work (AfriMMLU near chance ~23%, English-to-X generation weaker than X-to-English, unreliable Amharic Ge'ez output, calculator over-calling on hard expressions), which is why it is recorded at 0.4 rather than higher. Read the base column carefully: MMLU 29.8 is the author's own run of the base, and NVIDIA's own card for Nemotron-3-Nano-4B prints no MMLU at all, so 29.8 cannot be cross-checked against the vendor and is implausibly low for a 4B model - the +24 pt MMLU swing may be a harness artefact as much as a continued-pretraining gain. Licence inherited: NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License. Repo created 2026-09-22.

benchmarks.name: MMLU
benchmarks.config: Card 'Strengths (measured)' table '| Benchmark | Base | Crane Nemotron 4B |': MMLU (knowledge) 29.8 base vs 53.8 this. No shot count, harness or thinking setting printed. Cross-check failed: NVIDIA's own Nemotron-3-Nano-4B card prints no MMLU, so the 29.8 base cell is the author's run only and cannot be verified against the vendor.

benchmarks.config: Same table: GSM8K (math reasoning) 60.4 base vs 75.2 this. No shot count, harness or thinking setting printed. Not independently cross-checkable.
